change: Indirect variable, property and method references are now interpreted with left-to-right semantics.
note: $$foo['bar']['baz'] is flagged as a variable variable, but $foo->$bar['baz'], $foo->$bar['baz']() and Foo::$bar['baz']() are not reported.

change: The global keyword now only accepts simple variables.
note: global $$foo->bar is reported as a variable variable.

change: Parentheses around variables or function calls no longer have any influence on behavior.
note: array_pop((getArray())) passing a parenthesized call result by reference is not reported.

change: Array elements or object properties that are automatically created during by-reference assignments will now result in a different order.
note: Ordering of elements auto-created by reference assignment only shows at runtime.

change: https://wiki.php.net/rfc/uniform_variable_syntax
note: RFC reference only; the change is classified under item 0.

change: https://wiki.php.net/rfc/abstract_syntax_tree
note: RFC reference only; the changes are classified under items 0, 6 and 7.

change: list() will no longer assign variables in reverse order.
note: list($array[], $array[], $array[]) = [1, 2, 3] (assignment order change) is not reported.

change: Empty list() assignments are no longer allowed.
note: Empty list() = $a, list(,,) = $a and nested empty list() are not reported.

change: list() no longer supports unpacking strings (while previously this was only supported in some cases).
note: Whether list() unpacks a string depends on the runtime type of the right-hand side.

change: https://wiki.php.net/rfc/abstract_syntax_tree#changes_to_list
note: RFC reference only; the change is classified under items 6 and 7.

change: https://wiki.php.net/rfc/fix_list_behavior_inconsistency
note: RFC reference only; the change is classified under item 8.

change: Iteration with foreach() no longer has any effect on the internal array pointer, which can be accessed through the current()/next()/etc family of functions.
note: current($array) inside foreach ($array as &$val) is not reported.

change: When iterating arrays by-value, foreach will now always operate on a copy of the array, as such changes to the array during iteration will not influence iteration behavior.
note: Old behavior only appeared when the array was referenced elsewhere and modified during iteration.

change: When iterating arrays by-reference, modifications to the array will continue to influence the iteration.
note: By-reference iteration position changes depend on runtime modifications of the array.

change: Iteration of plain (non-Traversable) objects by-value or by-reference will behave like by-reference iteration of arrays.
note: Plain object iteration position handling depends on runtime modifications.

change: Iteration of Traversable objects remains unchanged.
note: Traversable iteration is unchanged.

change: It is no longer possible to define two function parameters with the same name.
note: function foo($a, $b, $unused, $unused) with duplicate parameter names is not reported.

change: The func_get_arg() and func_get_args() functions will no longer return the original value that was passed to a parameter and will instead provide the current value (which might have been modified).
note: func_get_arg(0) after the parameter is modified ($x++) is not reported.

change: Similarly exception backtraces will no longer display the original value that was passed to a function and show the modified value instead.
note: Only affects backtrace display, not program behavior.

change: Invalid octal literals (containing digits larger than 7) now produce compile errors.
note: Invalid octal literal $i = 0781 is not reported.

change: Bitwise shifts by negative numbers will now throw an ArithmeticError:
note: Literal negative shift 1 >> -1 is not reported.

change: Left bitwise shifts by a number of bits beyond the bit width of an integer will always result in 0:
note: Literal over-wide shift 1 << 64 is not reported.

change: Similarly right bitwise shifts by a number of bits beyond the bit width of an integer will always result in 0 or -1 (depending on sign):
note: Literal over-wide right shift 1 >> 64 is not reported.

change: Strings that contain hexadecimal numbers are no longer considered to be numeric and don't receive special treatment anymore.
note: Literal hex numeric strings like is_numeric("0x123") or "0x123" == "291" are not reported.

change: Due to the addition of the Unicode Codepoint Escape Syntax for double-quoted strings and heredocs, "\u{" followed by an invalid sequence will now result in an error:
note: Invalid "\u{xyz}" escape in a double-quoted string is not reported.

change: https://wiki.php.net/rfc/remove_hex_support_in_numeric_strings
note: RFC reference only; the change is classified under item 23.

change: https://wiki.php.net/rfc/unicode_escape
note: RFC reference only; the change is classified under item 24.

note: set_exception_handler(function (Exception $e) {...}) is reported.

change: Some fatal errors and recoverable fatal errors now throw an Error instead.
note: Which errors become Error and escape catch (Exception) depends on runtime failures.

change: Parser errors now generate a ParseError that extends Error.
note: eval() usage is reported for review of ParseError handling.

change: Constructors of internal classes will now always throw an exception on failure.
note: Whether an internal constructor fails depends on runtime arguments.

change: The error level of some E_STRICT notices has been changed.
note: Error level reclassification of E_STRICT notices does not change application source.

change: https://wiki.php.net/rfc/engine_exceptions_for_php7
note: RFC reference only; the change is classified under item 28.

change: https://wiki.php.net/rfc/throwable-interface
note: RFC reference only; the change is classified under item 27.

change: https://wiki.php.net/rfc/internal_constructor_behaviour
note: RFC reference only; the change is classified under item 30.

change: https://wiki.php.net/rfc/reclassify_e_strict
note: RFC reference only; the change is classified under item 31.

change: Removed support for static calls to non-static methods from an incompatible $this context.
note: A::test() called from unrelated class B is reported.

change: It is no longer possible to use the following class, interface and trait names (case-insensitive):
note: Class declarations, use aliases and class_alias() with the reserved name are reported.

change: The yield language construct no longer requires parentheses when used in an expression context.
note: echo yield -1; and yield $foo or die; precedence change is not reported.

change: Removed ASP (<%) and script (<script language=php>) tags.
note: ASP tags <% ... %> and <script language="php"> are not reported.

change: Removed support for assigning the result of new by reference.
note: $a = &new Foo is reported.

change: Removed support for scoped calls to non-static methods from an incompatible $this context.
note: Scoped call A::test() from an incompatible context is reported.

change: Removed support for #-style comments in ini files.
note: A '# comment' line in php.ini is not reported.

change: $HTTP_RAW_POST_DATA is no longer available.
note: $HTTP_RAW_POST_DATA is reported.

change: substr() now returns an empty string instead of FALSE when the truncation happens on boundaries.
note: substr(...) === false checks are not reported.

change: call_user_method() and call_user_method_array() no longer exists.
note: call_user_method() and call_user_method_array() are reported.

change: ob_start() no longer issues an E_ERROR, but instead an E_RECOVERABLE_ERROR in case an output buffer is created in an output buffer handler.
note: Depends on ob_start() being called inside an output handler at runtime.

change: The internal sorting algorithm has been improved, what may result in different sort order of elements that compare as equal.
note: Sort order of equal elements depends on data.

change: Removed dl() function on fpm-fcgi.
note: dl() is only unavailable under the fpm-fcgi SAPI, decided at deployment time; dl() calls are not reported.

change: setcookie() with an empty cookie name now issues a WARNING and doesn't send an empty set-cookie header line anymore.
note: setcookie('', 'v') is reported.

change: Removed support for disabling the CURLOPT_SAFE_UPLOAD option.
note: curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SAFE_UPLOAD, false) is reported.

change: curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_CERTINFO) returns certificate Subject and Issuer as a string (PHP >= 5.6.25)
note: curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_CERTINFO) whose result format changed is not reported.

change: Removed $is_dst parameter from mktime() and gmmktime().
note: mktime() and gmmktime() with the 7th $is_dst argument are reported.

change: dba_delete() now returns false if the key was not found for the inifile handler, too.
note: dba_delete() return value depends on the handler and key at runtime.

change: Requires libgmp version 4.2 or newer now.
note: libgmp build requirement.

change: gmp_setbit() and gmp_clrbit() now return FALSE for negative indices, making them consistent with other GMP functions.
note: gmp_setbit($g, -1) is reported.

change: Removed deprecated aliases datefmt_set_timezone_id() and IntlDateFormatter::setTimeZoneID().
note: datefmt_set_timezone_id() is reported, but IntlDateFormatter::setTimeZoneID() is not, even on a new IntlDateFormatter receiver.

change: Added LIBXML_BIGLINES parser option.
note: New libxml constant added.

change: Removed deprecated mcrypt_generic_end() alias in favor of mcrypt_generic_deinit().
note: mcrypt_generic_end() is reported.

change: Removed deprecated mcrypt_ecb(), mcrypt_cbc(), mcrypt_cfb() and mcrypt_ofb() functions in favor of mcrypt_encrypt() and mcrypt_decrypt() with an MCRYPT_MODE_* flag.
note: mcrypt_ecb() and mcrypt_cbc() are reported.

change: session_start() accepts all INI settings as array.
note: New session_start() option support; no break.

change: Save handler accepts validate_sid(), update_timestamp() which validates session ID existence, updates timestamp of session data.
note: New save handler callbacks; old handlers keep working.

change: SessionUpdateTimestampHandlerInterface is added.
note: New interface added.

change: session.lazy_write(default=On) INI setting enables only write session data when session data is updated.
note: New INI setting with a compatible default.

change: session_regenerate_id() saves current $_SESSION before creating new session ID.
note: Session save timing on regeneration only shows at runtime.

change: Removed opcache.load_comments configuration directive.
note: opcache.load_comments=0 in php.ini is not reported.

change: Removed the "rsa_key_size" SSL context option in favor of automatically setting the appropriate size given the negotiated crypto algorithm.
note: 'rsa_key_size' SSL context option in stream_context_create() is not reported.

change: Removed "CN_match" and "SNI_server_name" SSL context options.
note: 'CN_match' and 'SNI_server_name' SSL context options are not reported.

change: Removed support for /e (PREG_REPLACE_EVAL) modifier.
note: preg_replace('/a/e', ...) is reported.

change: Removed PGSQL_ATTR_DISABLE_NATIVE_PREPARED_STATEMENT attribute in favor of ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES.
note: PDO::PGSQL_ATTR_DISABLE_NATIVE_PREPARED_STATEMENT is reported.

change: Removed string category support in setlocale().
note: setlocale('LC_ALL', 'en_US') is reported.

change: Removed set_magic_quotes_runtime() and its alias magic_quotes_runtime().
note: set_magic_quotes_runtime() and magic_quotes_runtime() are reported.

change: Rejected RFC 7159 incompatible number formats in json_decode string - top level (07, 0xff, .1, -.1) and all levels ([1.], [1.e1])
note: Depends on the JSON input data.

change: Calling json_decode with 1st argument equal to empty PHP string or value that after casting to string is empty string (NULL, FALSE) results in JSON syntax error.
note: Depends on json_decode() input being empty at runtime.

change: Removed set_socket_blocking() in favor of its alias stream_set_blocking().
note: set_socket_blocking() is reported.

change: xml_set_object() now requires to manually unset the $parser when finished, to avoid memory leaks.
note: xml_set_object() is reported (via its 8.4 deprecation rule).

change: Removed xsl.security_prefs ini option.
note: xsl.security_prefs in php.ini or ini_set('xsl.security_prefs', ...) is not reported.

change: PHP 4 style constructors, where the constructor name is the same as the class name, are now deprecated.
note: class Foo { function Foo() {} } is reported.

change: Static calls to non-static methods are now deprecated.
note: A::m() on a non-static method is reported.

change: The "capture_session_meta" SSL context option is now deprecated.
note: 'capture_session_meta' SSL context option is not reported.

change: Removed asp_tags ini directive.
note: asp_tags=On in php.ini and .htaccess is reported.

change: Removed always_populate_raw_post_data ini directive.
note: always_populate_raw_post_data in php.ini or ini_set() is not reported.

change: 'void' can no longer be used as the name of a class, interface, or trait.
note: Class declarations, use aliases and class_alias() with the reserved name are reported.

change: 'iterable' can no longer be used as the name of a class, interface, or trait.
note: Class declarations, use aliases and class_alias() with the reserved name are reported.

change: (int), intval() where $base is 10 or unspecified, settype(), decbin(), decoct(), dechex(), integer operators and other conversions now always respect scientific notation in numeric strings.
note: Depends on numeric string values at runtime.

change: The ASCII 0x7F Delete control character is no longer permitted in unquoted identifiers in source code.
note: An identifier containing byte 0x7F is not reported.

change: If the error_log is set to syslog, the PHP error levels are mapped to the syslog error levels.
note: Syslog level mapping is a logging configuration detail.

change: Don't call destructors of incompletely constructed objects, even if they are kept referenced.
note: Depends on a constructor failing at runtime.

change: call_user_func() will now consistently throw a warning if a function with reference arguments is called.
note: Depends on the callee's by-reference signature at runtime.

change: rand() and srand() are now aliases of mt_rand() and mt_srand().
note: Seeded srand(42)/rand() sequences whose output changed are not reported.

change: Fixes to random number generators mean that mt_rand() now produces a different sequence of outputs to previous versions.
note: mt_srand(5) followed by mt_rand() relying on a deterministic sequence is not reported.

change: URL rewriter has been improved.
note: URL rewriter output depends on runtime INI settings and output.

change: Calling a function with less arguments than mandatory declared ones in signature now issues a Fatal Error (Error Exception) instead of a Warning.
note: Calling f($a, $b) as f(1) is reported.

change: The error message for E_RECOVERABLE errors has been changed from "Catchable fatal error" to "Recoverable fatal error".
note: Error message wording change.

change: The empty index operator (e.g. $str[] = $x) is not supported for strings anymore, and throws a fatal error instead of silently converting to array.
note: Whether $x[] = ... targets a string depends on the runtime type.

change: Array elements or object properties that are automatically created during by-reference assignments will now result in a different order.
note: Ordering of elements auto-created by reference assignment only shows at runtime.

change: The allowed_classes element of the $options parameter of unserialize() is now strictly typed, i.e. if anything other than an array or a boolean is given, unserialize() returns FALSE and issues an…

change: $this, autoglobals, and variables with the same name as a parameter can no longer be bound to a closure via the use construct.

change: An empty key is decoded as an empty property name instead of using _empty_ property name when decoding object to stdClass.

change: When calling json_encode with JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE option, U+2028 and U+2029 are escaped.
note: Depends on data containing U+2028/U+2029.

change: mb_ereg() and mb_eregi() will now set the $regs argument to an empty array, if nothing matched.
note: Depends on match results at runtime.

change: Dropped sslv2 stream.

change: gettype() will now return "resource (closed)" instead of "unknown type" for closed resources.

change: is_object() will now return true for objects of class __PHP_Incomplete_Class.

change: Unqualified references to undefined constants now generate a Warning instead of a notice.

change: Minimum supported Windows versions are Windows 7/Server 2008 R2.

change: "object" (in any case) can no longer be used as a class name.

change: The bcmod() function no longer truncates fractional numbers to integers.
note: Depends on bcmod() operands being fractional at runtime.

change: The json_decode() option JSON_OBJECT_AS_ARRAY is used if the second parameter (assoc) is null.

change: TypeError now reports wrong types as `int` and `bool` instead of `integer` and `boolean`.

change: References returned by array and property accesses are now unwrapped as part of the access.

change: Argument unpacking stopped working with Traversables with non-integer keys.

change: All warnings thrown by BCMath functions are now using PHP's error handling.

change: bcmul() and bcpow() now return numbers with the requested scale.

change: Using CURLPIPE_HTTP1 is deprecated, and is no longer supported as of cURL 7.62.0.
note: CURLPIPE_HTTP1 is not reported.

change: The $version parameter of curl_version() is deprecated.
note: curl_version(5) with an argument is reported.

change: Calling var_dump() or similar on a DateTime(Immutable) instance will no longer leave behind accessible properties on the object.
note: Depends on var_dump side effects at runtime.

change: Comparison of DateInterval objects (using ==, < and so on) will now generate a warning and always return false.
note: Depends on operand types being DateInterval at runtime.

change: As of PHP 7.4.4, the value of the $childNodes property of DOMDocument, DOMNode, DOMProcessingInstruction, DOMComment, DOMText, DOMCdataSection and DOMNotation is now an empty DOMNodeList instead…
note: Depends on DOM objects at runtime.

change: The default parameter value of idn_to_ascii() and idn_to_utf8() is now INTL_IDNA_VARIANT_UTS46 instead of the deprecated INTL_IDNA_VARIANT_2003.
note: idn_to_ascii('x') / idn_to_utf8('x') relying on the changed default variant are not reported.

change: The embedded server functionality has been removed.
note: mysqli_embedded_server_start() and mysqli_embedded_server_end() are not reported.

change: The undocumented mysqli::$stat property has been removed in favor of mysqli::stat().
note: $mysqli->stat property access on a new mysqli() is not reported.

change: The openssl_random_pseudo_bytes() function will now throw an exception in error situations, similar to random_bytes().
note: Depends on the requested length and entropy at runtime.

change: The $restart_syscalls flag for pcntl_signal() will now be respected for SIGALARM.
note: Signal restart behavior at runtime.

change: When PREG_UNMATCHED_AS_NULL mode is used, trailing unmatched capturing groups will now also be set to null (or [null, -1] if offset capture is enabled).
note: Depends on match results at runtime.

change: Installation of PEAR (including PECL) is no longer enabled by default.
note: PEAR installation build option.

change: Attempting to serialize a PDO or PDOStatement instance will now generate an Exception rather than a PDOException, consistent with other internal classes which do not support serialization.
note: Depends on serializing PDO objects at runtime.

change: Reflection objects will now generate an exception if an attempt is made to serialize them.
note: Depends on serializing Reflection objects at runtime.

change: The signature of the ReflectionMethod::getClosure() method changed to account for existing behavior with static methods:
note: Signature change is LSP compatible.

change: Starting with 7.4.11, incoming cookie names are not url-decoded.
note: SAPI cookie name decoding of incoming requests.

change: Calling get_object_vars() on an ArrayObject instance will now always return the properties of the ArrayObject itself (or a subclass).
note: Depends on ArrayObject instances at runtime.

change: SplPriorityQueue::setExtractFlags() will throw an exception if zero is passed.
note: $q->setExtractFlags(0) on SplPriorityQueue with a literal zero is not reported.

change: ArrayObject, ArrayIterator, SplDoublyLinkedList and SplObjectStorage now support the __serialize() + __unserialize() mechanism in addition to the Serializable interface.
note: Serialization payload compatibility across versions at runtime.

change: The "o" serialization format has been removed.
note: Only affects unserializing crafted strings.

change: Password hashing algorithm identifiers are now nullable strings rather than integers.
note: Comparing PASSWORD_BCRYPT === 1 (integer identifier) is not reported.

change: htmlentities() will now throw a notice (instead of a strict standards warning) if it is used with an encoding for which only basic entity substitution is supported, in which case it is equivalent…
note: Depends on the encoding value at runtime.

change: fread() and fwrite() will now return false if the operation failed.
note: Depends on I/O failures at runtime.

change: fread() and fwrite() on plain files will now throw a notice on failure, such as when trying to write to a read-only file resource.
note: Depends on I/O failures at runtime.

change: The stream_read() and stream_write() methods on stream wrappers now interpret "false" as a failure return values.
note: Depends on what user stream wrapper methods return at runtime.

change: round(-0.0) will now return -0.0 rather than +0.0.
note: Depends on values at runtime.

change: token_get_all() will now emit a T_BAD_CHARACTER token for unexpected characters instead of leaving behind holes in the token stream.
note: Depends on tokenized input at runtime.

change: Nesting ternary operators without explicit parentheses is deprecated:
note: $a ? $b : $c ? $d : $e is reported.

change: The array and string offset access syntax using curly braces is deprecated.
note: $str{0} is reported.

change: The (real) cast is deprecated, use (float) instead.
note: (real) cast is reported.

change: Unbinding $this of a non-static method through a combination of ReflectionMethod::getClosure() and closure rebinding is deprecated.
note: Depends on closure rebinding at runtime.

change: Unbinding $this of a non-static closure that uses $this is deprecated.
note: Depends on closure rebinding at runtime.

change: Using "parent" inside a class without a parent is deprecated, and will throw a compile-time error in the future.
note: parent::f() in a class without a parent is reported.

change: The allow_url_include ini directive is deprecated.
note: allow_url_include=On in php.ini is reported.

change: Importing type libraries with case-insensitive constant registering has been deprecated.
note: com_load_typelib('Word.Application', false) with case-insensitive registration is not reported.

change: FILTER_SANITIZE_MAGIC_QUOTES is deprecated, use FILTER_SANITIZE_ADD_SLASHES instead.
note: FILTER_SANITIZE_MAGIC_QUOTES is reported.

change: Passing a non-string pattern to mb_ereg_replace() is deprecated.
note: mb_ereg_replace(65, 'b', $s) is reported.

change: Passing the encoding as 3rd parameter to mb_strrpos() is deprecated.
note: mb_strrpos($h, $n, 'UTF-8') is reported.

change: ldap_control_paged_result_response and ldap_control_paged_result are deprecated.
note: ldap_control_paged_result() and ldap_control_paged_result_response() are reported.

change: Calls to ReflectionType::__toString() now generate a deprecation notice.
note: (string) $method->getReturnType() / ReflectionType::__toString() is not reported.

change: The export() methods on all Reflection classes are deprecated.
note: ReflectionClass::export() and ReflectionFunction::export() are reported.

change: The AI_IDN_ALLOW_UNASSIGNED and AI_IDN_USE_STD3_ASCII_RULES flags for socket_addrinfo_lookup() are deprecated, due to an upstream deprecation in glibc.
note: AI_IDN_ALLOW_UNASSIGNED and AI_IDN_USE_STD3_ASCII_RULES are not reported.

change: Passing invalid characters to ''base_convert()'', ''bindec()'', ''octdec()'' and ''hexdec()'' will now generate a deprecation notice.
note: bindec(), hexdec() and octdec() with literal invalid digits are reported; base_convert() is not.

change: Using array_key_exists() on objects is deprecated.
note: array_key_exists('k', $this) or on a new stdClass object is not reported.

change: The is_real() function is deprecated, use is_float() instead.
note: is_real() is reported.

change: The get_magic_quotes_gpc() and get_magic_quotes_runtime() functions are deprecated.
note: get_magic_quotes_gpc() and get_magic_quotes_runtime() are reported.

change: The hebrevc() function is deprecated.
note: hebrevc() is reported.

change: The convert_cyr_string() function is deprecated.
note: convert_cyr_string() is reported.

change: The money_format() function is deprecated.
note: money_format() is reported.

change: The ezmlm_hash() function is deprecated.
note: ezmlm_hash() is reported.

change: The restore_include_path() function is deprecated.
note: restore_include_path() is reported.

change: Passing parameters to implode() in reverse order is deprecated, use implode($glue, $parts) instead of implode($parts, $glue).
note: implode($parts, ', ') with reversed arguments is reported.

change: The interbase extension has been moved to PECL.
note: ibase_connect() is reported.

change: The recode extension has been moved to PECL.
note: recode_string() is reported.

change: The WDDX extension has been deprecated and moved to PECL.
note: wddx_serialize_value() is reported.

change: `match` is now a reserved keyword.
note: function match() and class Match are reported; a bare call to an externally defined match() function is not.

change: Assertion failures now throw by default.
note: Whether an assert() fails depends on runtime values; assert.exception default change is not visible in source.

change: Methods with the same name as the class are no longer interpreted as constructors.
note: class Foo { function Foo() {} } is reported.

change: Removed ability to call non-static methods statically.
note: A::f() on a non-static method is reported, but is_callable(['A', 'f']) / is_callable('A::f') checks are not.

change: Removed (real) cast.
note: (real) $y is reported.

change: Removed (unset) cast.
note: (unset) $y is reported.

change: Removed track_errors ini directive.
note: $php_errormsg, ini_set('track_errors') and track_errors in php.ini/.htaccess are reported.

change: Removed the ability to define case-insensitive constants.
note: define('FOO', 1, true) is reported.

change: Access to undefined constants now always results in an Error exception.
note: Unquoted array keys ($a[foo]) are reported, but bareword constants elsewhere ($x = bar;) are not.

change: Removed ability to specify an autoloader using an __autoload() function.
note: function __autoload() is reported.

change: Removed the $errcontext argument for custom error handlers.
note: set_error_handler with a five-parameter closure is reported.

change: Removed create_function().
note: create_function() is reported.

change: Removed each(). foreach or ArrayIterator should be used instead.
note: each() is reported.

change: Removed ability to unbind $this from closures that were created from a method, using Closure::fromCallable() or ReflectionMethod::getClosure().
note: Unbinding $this from a fromCallable/getClosure closure depends on what the closure variable holds at runtime.

change: Also removed ability to unbind $this from proper closures that contain uses of $this.
note: bindTo(null)/Closure::bind(..., null) on a closure using $this was tested and not reported; the closure is normally passed via variables, so it is runtime.

change: Removed ability to use array_key_exists() with objects.
note: Whether array_key_exists() receives an object depends on the runtime type of its argument.

change: Made the behavior of array_key_exists() regarding the type of the key parameter consistent with isset() and normal array access.
note: Key type coercion in array_key_exists() depends on runtime key values.

change: Any array that has a number n as its first numeric key will use n+1 for its next implicit key, even if n is negative.
note: Not reported: an array literal with a negative first key followed by an implicit key, e.g. $a = [-5 => 'a', 'b']; or array_fill(-5, 3, 0).

change: The default error_reporting level is now E_ALL.
note: Change of the default error_reporting level; not expressed in application source.

change: display_startup_errors is now enabled by default.
note: Change of the display_startup_errors default; not expressed in application source.

change: Using "parent" inside a class that has no parent will now result in a fatal compile-time error.
note: parent::f() in a class without a parent is reported.

change: The @ operator will no longer silence fatal errors (E_ERROR, E_CORE_ERROR, E_COMPILE_ERROR, E_USER_ERROR, E_RECOVERABLE_ERROR, E_PARSE).
note: An error handler testing error_reporting() == 0 is reported.

change: Following the hash comment operator # immediately with an opening bracket is not supported as a comment anymore since this syntax is now used for attributes.
note: A '#[' comment is reported.

change: Inheritance errors due to incompatible method signatures (LSP violations) will now always generate a fatal error.
note: A child method with an incompatible signature to its user-defined parent is reported.

change: The precedence of the concatenation operator has changed relative to bitshifts and addition as well as subtraction.
note: echo "Sum: " . $a + $b; is reported.

change: Arguments with a default value that resolves to null at runtime will no longer implicitly mark the argument type as nullable.
note: Not reported: const FOO = null; function t(int $a = FOO) {} (only explicit = null defaults are flagged).

change: A number of warnings have been converted into Error exceptions:
note: Writing properties/indexes on non-objects/scalars etc. depends on runtime value types.

change: Attempting to assign multiple bytes to a string offset will now emit a warning.
note: Multi-byte assignment to a string offset depends on runtime string values.

change: Unexpected characters in source files (such as null bytes outside of strings) will now result in a ParseError exception instead of a compile warning.
note: Not reported: a source file containing a NUL byte outside strings, e.g. '<?php $x = 1;\0'.

change: Uncaught exceptions now go through "clean shutdown", which means that destructors will be called after an uncaught exception.
note: Destructor execution after uncaught exceptions is runtime behavior.

change: Compile time fatal error "Only variables can be passed by reference" has been delayed until runtime and converted to "Argument cannot be passed by reference" exception.
note: The code was already a compile-time fatal error in PHP 7, so working code cannot contain it.

change: Some "Only variables should be passed by reference" notices have been converted to "Argument cannot be passed by reference" exception.
note: Which by-reference notices became exceptions depends on runtime call targets; end(explode()) and &array_pop() were not reported.

change: The generated name for anonymous classes has changed.
note: Only code comparing generated anonymous class names at runtime is affected.

change: Non-absolute trait method references in trait alias adaptations are now required to be unambiguous:
note: Not reported: class X { use T1, T2 { func as otherFunc; } } where both traits define func().

change: The signature of abstract methods defined in traits is now checked against the implementing class method:
note: Not reported: a class implementing a trait's abstract method with an incompatible return type (string vs int).

change: Disabled functions are now treated exactly like non-existent functions.
note: Disabled functions depend on the server's disable_functions configuration at runtime.

change: data: stream wrappers are no longer writable, which matches the documented behavior.
note: Not reported: writing to a literal data: URL, e.g. file_put_contents('data://text/plain,foo', 'x') or fopen('data:...', 'w').

change: The arithmetic and bitwise operators +, -, *, /, **, %, <<, >>, &, |, ^, ~, ++, -- will now consistently throw a TypeError when one of the operands is an array, resource or non-overloaded object.
note: Arithmetic on arrays/resources/objects depends on runtime operand types.

change: Float to string casting will now always behave locale-independently.
note: Float-to-string output differs only when a non-C LC_NUMERIC locale is active at runtime.

change: Removed support for deprecated curly braces for offset access RFC:
note: $s{0} is reported.

change: Applying the final modifier on a private method will now produce a warning unless that method is the constructor.
note: Not reported: final private function f() {} in a class.

change: If an object constructor exit()s, the object destructor will no longer be called.
note: Destructor behavior after exit() in a constructor is runtime behavior.

change: Non-strict comparisons between numbers and non-numeric strings now work by casting the number to string and comparing the strings.
note: Number vs non-numeric string comparison results depend on runtime values.

change: Namespaced names can no longer contain whitespace:
note: Not reported: whitespace inside namespaced names, e.g. new Foo \ Bar(); or use Foo \ Baz;.

change: Nested ternaries now require explicit parentheses.
note: $a ? $b : $c ? $d : $e is reported.

change: debug_backtrace() and Exception::getTrace() will no longer provide references to arguments.
note: Only code modifying arguments through debug_backtrace() results at runtime is affected.

change: Numeric string handling has been altered to be more intuitive and less error-prone.
note: Numeric string handling depends on runtime string values.

change: Magic Methods will now have their arguments and return types checked if they have them declared.
note: Not reported: magic methods with wrong declared types, e.g. public function __get(int $name) or __clone(): int.

change: call_user_func_array() array keys will now be interpreted as parameter names, instead of being silently ignored.
note: Not reported: call_user_func_array('f', ['a' => 1, 'b' => 2]) with literal string keys.

change: Removed the ability to import case-insensitive constants from type libraries.
note: Not reported: com_load_typelib('Word.Application', false) or com.autoregister_casesensitive = 0 in php.ini.

change: CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS no longer accepts objects as arrays.
note: Whether CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS receives an object depends on the runtime value.

change: mktime() and gmmktime() now require at least one argument.
note: mktime() and gmmktime() with no arguments are reported.

change: Remove unimplemented classes from ext/dom that had no behavior and contained test data.
note: new DOMConfiguration() is reported; type hints/instanceof on these classes do not fail at runtime.

change: enchant_broker_list_dicts(), enchant_broker_describe() and enchant_dict_suggest() will now return an empty array instead of null.
note: Return value change (empty array instead of null) only matters for runtime checks on the result.

change: enchant_broker_init() will now return an EnchantBroker object rather than a resource.
note: is_resource() on enchant_broker_init() result is reported.

change: enchant_broker_request_dict() and enchant_broker_request_pwl_dict() will now return an EnchantDictionary object rather than a resource.
note: is_resource() on enchant_broker_request_dict() is reported, but on enchant_broker_request_pwl_dict() it is not.

change: Removed read_exif_data().
note: read_exif_data() is reported.

change: The FILTER_FLAG_SCHEME_REQUIRED and FILTER_FLAG_HOST_REQUIRED flags for the FILTER_VALIDATE_URL filter have been removed.
note: Both FILTER_FLAG_*_REQUIRED constants are reported.

change: The INPUT_REQUEST and INPUT_SESSION source for filter_input() etc have been removed.
note: INPUT_REQUEST and INPUT_SESSION are reported.

change: The GD extension now uses a GdImage objects as the underlying data structure for images, rather than resources.
note: is_resource() on an imagecreatetruecolor() result is reported.

change: The deprecated function image2wbmp() has been removed.
note: image2wbmp() is reported.

change: The deprecated functions png2wbmp() and jpeg2wbmp() have been removed.
note: png2wbmp() and jpeg2wbmp() are reported.

change: The default $mode parameter of imagecropauto() no longer accepts -1.
note: imagecropauto($im, -1) is reported.

change: gmp_random() has been removed.
note: gmp_random() is reported.

change: iconv() implementations which do not properly set errno in case of errors are no longer supported.
note: Concerns the iconv implementation PHP is built against.

change: The unused default_host argument of imap_headerinfo() has been removed.
note: imap_headerinfo() with five arguments is reported, via the ext/imap unbundling rule rather than the argument removal.

change: The imap_header() function which is an alias of imap_headerinfo() has been removed.
note: imap_header() is reported via the ext/imap unbundling rule.

change: The deprecated constant INTL_IDNA_VARIANT_2003 has been removed.
note: INTL_IDNA_VARIANT_2003 is reported.

change: The deprecated Normalizer::NONE constant has been removed.
note: Not reported: Normalizer::normalize($s, Normalizer::NONE).

change: The IntlDateFormatter::RELATIVE_FULL, IntlDateFormatter::RELATIVE_LONG, IntlDateFormatter::RELATIVE_MEDIUM, and IntlDateFormatter::RELATIVE_SHORT constants have been added.
note: New constants were added; existing code is unaffected.

change: The deprecated function ldap_sort has been removed.
note: ldap_sort() is reported.

change: The deprecated function ldap_control_paged_result has been removed.
note: ldap_control_paged_result() is reported.

change: The deprecated function ldap_control_paged_result_response has been removed.
note: ldap_control_paged_result_response() is reported.

change: The interface of ldap_set_rebind_proc has changed; the $callback parameter does not accept empty string anymore; null value shall be used instead.
note: ldap_set_rebind_proc($l, '') is reported.

change: The mbstring.func_overload directive has been removed.
note: MB_OVERLOAD_* constants, ini_set and php.ini/.htaccess mbstring.func_overload are reported; mb_get_info('func_overload') is not.

change: mb_parse_str() can no longer be used without specifying a result array.
note: mb_parse_str($q) with one argument is reported.

change: A number of deprecated mbregex aliases have been removed.
note: mbregex_encoding(), mbereg(), mberegi(), mbereg_replace() and mbsplit() are reported.

change: The 'e' modifier for mb_ereg_replace() has been removed.
note: mb_ereg_replace('a', $c, $s, 'e') is reported.

change: A non-string pattern argument to mb_ereg_replace() will now be interpreted as a string instead of an ASCII codepoint.
note: mb_ereg_replace(65, 'b', $s) is reported.

change: The needle argument for mb_strpos(), mb_strrpos(), mb_stripos(), mb_strripos(), mb_strstr(), mb_stristr(), mb_strrchr() and mb_strrichr() can now be empty.
note: Return value for an empty needle changes; the needle is normally a variable.

change: The $is_hex parameter, which was not used internally, has been removed from mb_decode_numericentity().
note: mb_decode_numericentity() with a fourth $is_hex argument is reported.

change: The legacy behavior of passing the encoding as the third argument instead of an offset for the mb_strrpos() function has been removed; provide an explicit 0 offset with the encoding as the fourth…
note: mb_strrpos($h, $n, 'UTF-8') is reported.

change: The ISO_8859-* character encoding aliases have been replaced by ISO8859-* aliases for better interoperability with the iconv extension.
note: Not reported: literal 'ISO_8859-1' / 'ISO_8859_1' encoding names in mb_convert_encoding() or mb_regex_encoding().

change: mb_ereg() and mb_eregi() will now return boolean true on a successful match.
note: Return value change of mb_ereg() only matters for runtime use of the result.

change: The OCI-Lob class is now called OCILob, and the OCI-Collection class is now called OCICollection for name compliance enforced by PHP 8 arginfo type annotation tooling.
note: Not reported: class name string checks such as get_class($l) === 'OCI-Lob'.

change: Several alias functions have been marked as deprecated.
note: Not reported: deprecated OCI8 aliases without an oci_ prefix, e.g. ocilogon(), ociparse(), ociexecute().

change: oci_internal_debug() and its alias ociinternaldebug() have been removed.
note: oci_internal_debug() is reported, but its alias ociinternaldebug() is not.

change: odbc_connect() no longer reuses persistent connections.
note: Connection pooling behavior of odbc_connect(); no source change required.

change: The unused flags parameter of odbc_exec() has been removed.
note: odbc_exec($c, $sql, 1) with the flags argument is reported.

change: openssl_x509_read() and openssl_csr_sign() will now return an OpenSSLCertificate object rather than a resource.
note: is_resource() on openssl_x509_read() is reported, but on openssl_csr_sign() it is not.

change: The openssl_x509_free() function is deprecated and no longer has an effect, instead the OpenSSLCertificate instance is automatically destroyed if it is no longer referenced.
note: openssl_x509_free() is reported.

change: openssl_csr_new() will now return an OpenSSLCertificateSigningRequest object rather than a resource.
note: is_resource() on openssl_csr_new() is reported.

change: openssl_pkey_new() will now return an OpenSSLAsymmetricKey object rather than a resource.
note: is_resource() on openssl_pkey_new() is reported.

change: The openssl_pkey_free() function is deprecated and no longer has an effect, instead the OpenSSLAsymmetricKey instance is automatically destroyed if it is no longer referenced.
note: openssl_pkey_free() is reported.

change: openssl_seal() and openssl_open() now require $method to be passed, as the previous default of "RC4" is considered insecure.
note: openssl_seal() and openssl_open() with four arguments (no method) are reported.

change: When passing invalid escape sequences they are no longer interpreted as literals.
note: Not reported: a literal regex with the X modifier or invalid escape, e.g. preg_match('/\i/X', $s).

change: The default error handling mode has been changed from "silent" to "exceptions".
note: Whether code relied on silent PDO errors depends on runtime query failures and error handling flow.

change: The signatures of some PDO methods have changed:
note: Subclasses overriding PDO::query() and PDOStatement::setFetchMode() with old signatures are reported.

change: PDO::inTransaction() now reports the actual transaction state of the connection, rather than an approximation maintained by PDO.
note: inTransaction() result depends on runtime transaction state.

change: The php.ini directive pdo_odbc.db2_instance_name has been removed
note: Not reported: pdo_odbc.db2_instance_name = db2inst1 in php.ini.

change: The deprecated pg_connect() syntax using multiple parameters instead of a connection string is no longer supported.
note: pg_connect() with five separate parameters is reported.

change: The deprecated pg_lo_import() and pg_lo_export() signature that passes the connection as the last argument is no longer supported.
note: Old vs new pg_lo_import()/pg_lo_export() argument order is indistinguishable when both arguments are variables.

change: pg_fetch_all() will now return an empty array instead of false for result sets with zero rows.
note: pg_fetch_all() result checks against false depend on runtime result sets.

change: Metadata associated with a phar will no longer be automatically unserialized, to fix potential security vulnerabilities due to object instantiation, autoloading, etc. RFC:
note: Phar metadata unserialization is runtime behavior.

change: The method signatures ReflectionClass::newInstance($args) ReflectionFunction::invoke($args) ReflectionMethod::invoke($object, $args) have been changed to:
note: Subclasses overriding ReflectionClass::newInstance()/ReflectionMethod::invoke() with old signatures are reported.

change: The ReflectionType::__toString() method will now return a complete debug representation of the type, and is no longer deprecated.
note: Only code parsing ReflectionType::__toString() output at runtime is affected.

change: Reflection export() methods have been removed.
note: ReflectionClass::export() and Reflection::export() are reported.

change: The following methods can now return information about default values of parameters of internal functions:
note: New capability for internal functions; existing code is unaffected.

change: ReflectionMethod::isConstructor() and ReflectionMethod::isDestructor() now also return true for `__construct` and `__destruct` methods of interfaces.
note: Return value change of isConstructor()/isDestructor() depends on the reflected method at runtime.

change: ReflectionType::isBuiltin() method has been moved to ReflectionNamedType.
note: Whether isBuiltin() is called on a ReflectionUnionType depends on the runtime type object.

change: The deprecated AI_IDN_ALLOW_UNASSIGNED and AI_IDN_USE_STD3_ASCII_RULES flags for socket_addrinfo_lookup() have been removed.
note: Not reported: AI_IDN_ALLOW_UNASSIGNED and AI_IDN_USE_STD3_ASCII_RULES constants.

change: socket_create(), socket_create_listen(), socket_accept(), socket_import_stream(), socket_addrinfo_connect(), socket_addrinfo_bind(), and socket_wsaprotocol_info_import() will now return a Socket…
note: is_resource() on socket_create() is reported, but on socket_import_stream() and socket_addrinfo_connect() it is not.

change: socket_addrinfo_lookup() will now return an array of AddressInfo objects rather than resources.
note: is_resource() checks on socket_addrinfo_lookup() array elements depend on data flow through arrays.

change: SplFileObject::fgetss() has been removed.
note: SplFileObject::fgetss() on a new SplFileObject is reported.

change: SplFileObject::seek() now always seeks to the beginning of the line.
note: seek() position change depends on runtime file content.

change: SplHeap::compare($a, $b) now specifies a method signature.
note: A SplHeap subclass with an incompatible compare() signature is reported.

change: SplDoublyLinkedList::push() now returns void instead of true
note: Only code using the return value of push() is affected, which needs the receiver type.

change: SplDoublyLinkedList::unshift() now returns void instead of true
note: Only code using the return value of unshift() is affected, which needs the receiver type.

change: SplQueue::enqueue() now returns void instead of true
note: Only code using the return value of enqueue() is affected, which needs the receiver type.

change: spl_autoload_register() will now always throw a TypeError on invalid arguments, therefore the second argument $do_throw is ignored and a notice will be emitted if it is set to false.
note: spl_autoload_register('loader', false) is reported.

change: SplFixedArray is now an IteratorAggregate and not an Iterator.
note: rewind()/valid()/current()/next() on a SplFixedArray are reported.

change: assert() will no longer evaluate string arguments, instead they will be treated like any other argument.
note: assert(...), ASSERT_QUIET_EVAL and the assert.quiet_eval setting are reported.

change: parse_str() can no longer be used without specifying a result array.
note: parse_str($q) with one argument is reported.

change: fgetss() has been removed.
note: fgetss() is reported.

change: The string.strip_tags filter has been removed.
note: stream_filter_append($fp, 'string.strip_tags') is reported.

change: The needle argument of strpos(), strrpos(), stripos(), strripos(), strstr(), strchr(), strrchr(), and stristr() will now always be interpreted as a string.
note: strstr($s, 10) is reported.

change: The needle argument for strpos(), strrpos(), stripos(), strripos(), strstr(), stristr() and strrchr() can now be empty.
note: Return value for an empty needle changes; the needle is normally a variable.

change: The length argument for substr(), substr_count(), substr_compare(), and iconv_substr() can now be null.
note: substr($s, 2, null) is reported.

change: The length argument for array_splice() can now be null.
note: array_splice($a, 1, null) is reported.

change: The args argument of vsprintf(), vfprintf(), and vprintf() must now be an array.
note: The args argument of vsprintf() is normally a variable whose type is known only at runtime.

change: The 'salt' option of password_hash() is no longer supported.
note: password_hash($p, PASSWORD_DEFAULT, ['salt' => $salt]) is reported.

change: The quotemeta() function will now return an empty string if an empty string was passed.
note: Return value for an empty input depends on runtime values.

change: hebrevc() has been removed.
note: hebrevc() is reported.

change: convert_cyr_string() has been removed.
note: convert_cyr_string() is reported.

change: money_format() has been removed.
note: money_format() is reported.

change: ezmlm_hash() has been removed.
note: ezmlm_hash() is reported.

change: restore_include_path() has been removed.
note: restore_include_path() is reported.

change: get_magic_quotes_gpc() and get_magic_quotes_runtime() has been removed.
note: get_magic_quotes_gpc() and get_magic_quotes_runtime() are reported.

change: FILTER_SANITIZE_MAGIC_QUOTES has been removed.
note: FILTER_SANITIZE_MAGIC_QUOTES is reported.

change: Calling implode() with parameters in a reverse order ($pieces, $glue) is no longer supported.
note: implode($pieces, ', ') with a known array first is reported.

change: parse_url() will now distinguish absent and empty queries and fragments:
note: Null vs empty query/fragment depends on runtime URLs.

change: var_dump() and debug_zval_dump() will now print floating-point numbers using serialize_precision rather than precision.
note: Debug output formatting of var_dump()/debug_zval_dump().

change: If the array returned by __sleep() contains non-existing properties, these are now silently ignored.
note: Depends on which properties exist at runtime when __sleep() runs.

change: The default locale on startup is now always "C".
note: Locale-dependent behavior depends on the runtime environment.

change: Removed deprecated DES fallback in crypt().
note: The crypt() salt format is normally a runtime value.

change: Specifying out of range rounds for sha256/sha512 crypt() will now fail with *0 instead of clamping to the closest limit.
note: The crypt() rounds value is normally a runtime value.

change: The result of sorting functions may have changed, if the array contains elements that compare as equal.
note: Sort result order for equal elements depends on runtime data.

change: Sort comparison functions that return true or false will now throw a deprecation warning, and should be replaced with an implementation that returns an integer less than, equal to, or greater than…
note: Not reported: usort($array, fn($a, $b) => $a > $b) with a boolean-returning comparator.

change: Any functions accepting callbacks that are not explicitly specified to accept parameters by reference will now warn if a callback with reference parameters is used.
note: Not reported: array_filter($a, function (&$v) {...}) / array_reduce with a by-reference callback parameter.

change: The HTTP stream wrapper as used by functions like file_get_contents() now advertises HTTP/1.1 rather than HTTP/1.0 by default.
note: HTTP protocol version advertised by the stream wrapper; no source change required.

change: Calling crypt() without an explicit salt is no longer supported.
note: crypt($pw) without a salt is reported.

change: substr(), mb_substr(), iconv_substr() and grapheme_substr() now consistently clamp out-of-bounds offsets to the string boundary.
note: Out-of-bounds offsets depend on runtime string lengths.

change: Populating $http_response_header variable by the HTTP stream wrapper doesn't force rebuilding of symbol table anymore.
note: Internal symbol table handling.

change: msg_get_queue() will now return an SysvMessageQueue object rather than a resource.
note: is_resource() on msg_get_queue() is reported.

change: sem_get() will now return an SysvSemaphore object rather than a resource.
note: is_resource() on sem_get() is reported.

change: The $auto_release parameter of sem_get() was changed to accept bool values rather than int.
note: An int auto_release is still coerced to bool outside strict_types; only typed runtime values in strict mode fail.

change: shm_attach() will now return an SysvSharedMemory object rather than a resource.
note: is_resource() on shm_attach() is reported.

change: The $use_include_path parameter, which was not used internally, has been removed from tidy_repair_string().
note: tidy_repair_string() with a fourth $use_include_path argument is reported.

change: tidy::repairString() and tidy::repairFile() became static methods
note: Not reported: class T extends tidy { public function repairString(...) {} } overriding a now-static method as non-static.

change: T_COMMENT tokens will no longer include a trailing newline.
note: Only code inspecting token_get_all() output at runtime is affected.

change: Namespaced names are now represented using the T_NAME_QUALIFIED (Foo\Bar), T_NAME_FULLY_QUALIFIED (\Foo\Bar) and T_NAME_RELATIVE (namespace\Foo\Bar) tokens.
note: Only code inspecting token_get_all() output at runtime is affected.

change: xml_parser_create(_ns) will now return an XMLParser object rather than a resource.
note: is_resource() on xml_parser_create() and xml_parser_free() are reported.

change: XMLReader::open() and XMLReader::xml() are now static methods.
note: A subclass overriding XMLReader::open()/xml() as non-static is reported.

change: The XMLWriter functions now accept and return, respectively, XMLWriter objects instead of resources.
note: is_resource() on xmlwriter_open_memory() is reported.

change: ZipArchive::OPSYS_Z_CPM has been removed (this name was a typo).
note: Not reported: ZipArchive::OPSYS_Z_CPM.

change: gzgetss() has been removed.
note: gzgetss() is reported.

change: inflate_init() will now return an InflateContext object rather than a resource.
note: is_resource() on inflate_init() is reported.

change: deflate_init() will now return a DeflateContext object rather than a resource.
note: is_resource() on deflate_init() is reported.

change: zlib.output_compression is no longer automatically disabled for Content-Type:
note: Output compression behavior for image content types; server-level runtime behavior.

change: Declaring a required parameter after an optional one is deprecated.
note: function f($a = 1, $b) {} is reported.

change: Calling get_defined_functions() with $exclude_disabled explicitly set to false is deprecated.
note: get_defined_functions(false) is reported.

change: enchant_broker_set_dict_path and enchant_broker_get_dict_path not available in libenchant < 1.5 nor in libenchant-2
note: enchant_broker_set_dict_path() and enchant_broker_get_dict_path() are reported.

change: enchant_dict_add_to_personal, use enchant_dict_add instead
note: enchant_dict_add_to_personal() is reported.

change: enchant_dict_is_in_session, use enchant_dict_is_added instead
note: enchant_dict_is_in_session() is reported.

change: enchant_broker_free and enchant_broker_free_dict, unset the object instead
note: enchant_broker_free() and enchant_broker_free_dict() are reported.

change: ENCHANT_MYSPELL and ENCHANT_ISPELL constants
note: ENCHANT_MYSPELL and ENCHANT_ISPELL are reported.

change: libxml_disable_entity_loader() has been deprecated.
note: libxml_disable_entity_loader() is reported.

change: The constant PGSQL_LIBPQ_VERSION_STR has now the same value as PGSQL_LIBPQ_VERSION, and thus is deprecated.
note: PGSQL_LIBPQ_VERSION_STR is reported.

change: Function aliases in the pgsql extension have been deprecated.
note: pg_numrows() is reported.

change: Using empty file as ZipArchive is deprecated.
note: Whether the opened file is empty depends on runtime data.

change: The procedural API of Zip is deprecated.
note: zip_open() and zip_read() are reported.

change: ReflectionFunction::isDisabled() is deprecated, as it is no longer possible to create a ReflectionFunction for a disabled function.
note: ReflectionFunction::isDisabled() is reported.

change: ReflectionParameter::getClass(), ReflectionParameter::isArray(), and ReflectionParameter::isCallable() are deprecated.
note: getClass(), isArray() and isCallable() on a ReflectionParameter are reported.

change: The xmlrpc extension has been unbundled and moved to PECL.
note: xmlrpc_encode() is reported.

change: Access to the $GLOBALS array is now subject to a number of restrictions.
note: array_pop($GLOBALS) and $GLOBALS = [] are reported.

change: Passing null to a non-nullable argument of a built-in function is deprecated.
note: str_contains('foobar', null) and strlen(null) are reported; null from variables is runtime.

change: When a method using static variables is inherited (but not overridden), the inherited method will now share static variables with the parent method.
note: Not reported: class A { static function counter() { static $c = 0; } } class B extends A {} B::counter(); shares the static now.

change: Most non-final internal methods now require overriding methods to declare a compatible return type, otherwise a deprecated notice is emitted during inheritance validation.
note: Override of ArrayIterator::current() without a return type is reported.

change: The fileinfo functions now accept and return, respectively, finfo objects instead of resources.
note: is_resource(finfo_open()) result is reported.

change: The FTP functions now accept and return, respectively, FTP\Connection objects instead of resources.
note: is_resource(ftp_connect()) result is reported.

change: The IMAP functions now accept and return, respectively, IMAP\Connection objects instead of resources.
note: is_resource(imap_open()) result is reported, along with the imap removal.

change: The LDAP functions now accept and return, respectively, LDAP\Connection objects instead of "ldap link" resources.
note: is_resource(ldap_connect()) result is reported.

change: The LDAP functions now accept and return, respectively, LDAP\Result objects instead of "ldap result" resources.
note: Not reported: $r = ldap_search($l, 'dc', 'x'); if (is_resource($r)) {} (only ldap_connect handles are tracked).

change: The LDAP functions now accept and return, respectively, LDAP\ResultEntry objects instead of "ldap result entry" resources.
note: Not reported: $e = ldap_first_entry($l, $r); if (is_resource($e)) {}.

change: mysqli_fetch_fields() and mysqli_fetch_field_direct() will now always return zero for max_length.
note: Not reported: mysqli_fetch_field_direct($r, 0)->max_length (or ->max_length on mysqli_fetch_fields() entries) is now always 0.

change: The MYSQLI_STMT_ATTR_UPDATE_MAX_LENGTH option no longer has an effect.
note: Not reported: mysqli_stmt_attr_set($s, MYSQLI_STMT_ATTR_UPDATE_MAX_LENGTH, true); the constant no longer has an effect.

change: The MYSQLI_STORE_RESULT_COPY_DATA option no longer has an effect.
note: MYSQLI_STORE_RESULT_COPY_DATA constant use is reported.

change: The default error handling mode has been changed from "silent" to "exceptions".
note: Not reported: mysqli_connect()/mysqli_query() results checked with === false and no mysqli_report() call, which now throw instead.

change: Classes extending mysqli_stmt::execute() will be required to specify the additional parameter now.
note: class S extends mysqli_stmt { function execute() {} } is reported.

change: mysqli::connect() will now return true instead of null on success.
note: Not reported: if ($m->connect('h','u','p') === null) on a new mysqli object; connect() now returns true.

change: The mysqlnd.fetch_data_copy ini setting has been removed.
note: mysqlnd.fetch_data_copy is reported in php.ini, .user.ini, .htaccess and ini_set().

change: EC private keys will now be exported in PKCS#8 format rather than traditional format, just like all other keys.
note: Export format depends on the key type created at runtime.

change: openssl_pkcs7_encrypt() and openssl_cms_encrypt() will now default to using AES-128-CBC rather than RC2-40.
note: openssl_pkcs7_encrypt('in', 'out', $cert, []) is reported.

change: PDO::ATTR_STRINGIFY_FETCHES now also stringifies values of type bool to "0" or "1".
note: Only matters when fetched column values are booleans, which depends on the database data.

change: Calling bindColumn() with PDO::PARAM_LOB (and assuming stringification is not enabled) will now consistently bind a stream result, as documented.
note: Not reported: $stmt->bindColumn(1, $lob, PDO::PARAM_LOB) now always binds a stream.

change: Integers and floats in result sets will now be returned using native PHP types instead of strings when using emulated prepared statements.
note: Native int/float results depend on the driver, emulation setting and column types at runtime.

change: Integers and floats in results sets will now be returned using native PHP types.
note: Native int/float results from PDO SQLite depend on the stored data at runtime.

change: The PgSQL functions now accept and return, respectively, \PgSql\Connection objects instead of "pgsql link" resources.
note: is_resource(pg_connect()) result is reported.

change: The PgSQL functions now accept and return, respectively, \PgSql\Result objects instead of "pgsql result" resources.
note: is_resource(pg_query()) result is reported.

change: The PgSQL functions now accept and return, respectively, \PgSql\Lob objects instead of "pgsql large object" resources.
note: Not reported: $l = pg_lo_open($c, 1, 'r'); if (is_resource($l)) {}.

change: To comply with the ArrayAccess interface, Phar::offsetUnset() and PharData::offsetUnset() no longer return a boolean.
note: Using the return value of ->offsetUnset() needs the receiver to be known as Phar/PharData; the method name is generic ArrayAccess.

change: The PSpell functions now accept and return, respectively, PSpell\Dictionary objects instead of "pspell" resources.
note: is_resource(pspell_new()) result is reported, plus the pspell removal.

change: The PSpell functions now accept and return, respectively, PSpell\Config objects instead of "pspell config" resources.
note: pspell_config_create() is reported via the pspell removal, though the is_resource() check on it is not tracked.

change: version_compare() no longer accepts undocumented operator abbreviations.
note: version_compare('1.0', '2.0', 'l') is reported.

change: htmlspecialchars(), htmlentities(), htmlspecialchars_decode(), html_entity_decode() and get_html_translation_table() now use ENT_QUOTES | ENT_SUBSTITUTE rather than ENT_COMPAT by default.
note: Statically detectable, but deliberately not reported: one-argument calls matched 445 lines across the corpus, and for most of them the only difference is that single quotes are now encoded.

change: debug_zval_dump() will now print reference wrappers with their refcount, instead of only prepending a "&" to the value.
note: debug_zval_dump() debugging output format only.

change: debug_zval_dump() will now print "interned" instead of a dummy refcount of one for interned strings and immutable arrays.
note: debug_zval_dump() debugging output format only.

change: SplFixedArray will now be JSON encoded like an array.
note: json_encode() of an SplFixedArray depends on the runtime value type.

change: Implementing the Serializable interface without also implementing __serialize() and __unserialize() has been deprecated.
note: Class implementing Serializable without __serialize/__unserialize is reported.

change: Implicit conversion of floats to integers that result in loss of precision, e.g. a truncation from 1.9 to 1, is deprecated.
note: Float-to-int loss usually comes from runtime values, but literal forms like $a[1.5] = 1, 7.5 % 2 and str_repeat('x', 2.5) are not reported.

change: Calling a static method or accessing a static property directly on a trait is deprecated.
note: Not reported: trait T { static function f() {} } T::f(); or T::$p accessed directly on the trait.

change: Returning a non-array from __sleep will raise a warning
note: Not reported: function __sleep() { return null; } returning a non-array literal.

change: Returning by reference from a void function is deprecated.
note: Not reported: function &f(): void {}.

change: Automatic conversion of "false" into an empty array on write operands is deprecated.
note: Mostly runtime, but literal $a = false; $a[] = 1; is not reported.

change: Passing a non-string value to ctype_*() functions is deprecated.
note: ctype_digit(5) is reported.

change: The date_sunrise() and date_sunset() functions have been deprecated in favor of date_sun_info().
note: date_sunrise() and date_sunset() calls are reported.

change: The strftime() and gmstrftime() functions have been deprecated in favor of date()/DateTime::format() (for locale-independent formatting) or IntlDateFormatter::format() (for locale-dependent…
note: strftime() and gmstrftime() calls are reported.

change: The FILTER_SANITIZE_STRING and FILTER_SANITIZE_STRIPPED filters have been deprecated.
note: Both filter constants are reported.

change: The filter.default ini setting is deprecated.
note: filter.default in php.ini and in ini_set() is reported.

change: The $num_points parameter of image(open|filled)polygon has been deprecated.
note: imagepolygon($im, $pts, 3, $col) is reported.

change: The mhash(), mhash_keygen_s2k(), mhash_count(), mhash_get_block_size() and mhash_get_hash_name() functions are deprecated.
note: mhash(), mhash_count() and MHASH_* constants are reported.

change: The NIL constant has been deprecated.
note: IMAP function calls are reported via the imap removal, but a standalone NIL constant (echo NIL;) is not.

change: Calling IntlCalendar::roll() with bool argument is deprecated.
note: intlcal_roll() with a bool literal is reported; the $cal->roll() method form is not.

change: Calling mb_check_encoding() without an argument is deprecated.
note: mb_check_encoding() without arguments is reported.

change: The mysqli_driver::$driver_version property has been deprecated.
note: Not reported: (new mysqli_driver())->driver_version property read.

change: Calling mysqli::get_client_info in OO style or passing $mysqli argument to mysqli_get_client_info() function has been deprecated.
note: mysqli_get_client_info($m) is reported.

change: The mysqli::init() method has been deprecated.
note: parent::init() in a mysqli subclass is reported.

change: The INI directive oci8.old_oci_close_semantics has been deprecated.
note: ini_set('oci8.old_oci_close_semantics', 1) is reported.

change: odbc_result_all() has been deprecated.
note: odbc_result_all() call is reported.

change: The PDO::FETCH_SERIALIZE mode has been deprecated.
note: PDO::FETCH_SERIALIZE is reported.

change: Not passing the connection argument to PgSQL functions and using the default connection is deprecated.
note: pg_query('SELECT 1') is reported.

change: The ssl_method option for the SoapClient constructor has been deprecated in favor of ssl stream context options.
note: Not reported: new SoapClient('x.wsdl', ['ssl_method' => SOAP_SSL_METHOD_TLS]).

change: Calling key(), current(), next(), prev(), reset(), or end() on objects is deprecated.
note: Generally needs the argument type, but obvious object forms like reset($this) / current($this) or key(new stdClass) are not reported.

change: The strptime() function has been deprecated.
note: strptime() call is reported.

change: The auto_detect_line_endings ini setting has been deprecated.
note: auto_detect_line_endings in php.ini and ini_set() is reported.

change: The FILE_BINARY and FILE_TEXT constants are deprecated.
note: FILE_TEXT and FILE_BINARY constants are reported.

change: DateTime::createFromImmutable() now has a tentative return type of static, previously it was DateTime.
note: DateTime subclass overriding createFromImmutable(): DateTime is reported.

change: DateTimeImmutable::createFromMutable() now has a tentative return type of static, previously it was DateTimeImmutable.
note: DateTimeImmutable subclass overriding createFromMutable(): DateTimeImmutable is reported.

change: The ODBC extension now escapes the username and password for the case when both a connection string and username/password are passed, and the string must be appended to.

change: The PDO_ODBC extension also escapes the username and password when a connection string is passed.
note: Escaping only matters when runtime username/password values contain special characters.

change: glob() returns empty array if all paths are restricted by open_basedir.
note: Depends on the open_basedir configuration and runtime paths.

change: strtolower() and strtoupper() are no longer locale-sensitive.
note: Only differs when a non-C locale is active at runtime and input has non-ASCII bytes.

change: str_split() returns an empty array for an empty string now.
note: Only differs when the string passed to str_split() is empty at runtime.

change: ksort() and krsort() do numeric string comparison under SORT_REGULAR using the standard PHP 8 rules now.
note: Depends on the runtime keys being numeric strings.

note: SplFileObject subclass overriding getChildren(): ?RecursiveIterator is reported.

change: GlogIterator returns empty array if all paths are restricted by open_basedir.
note: Depends on the open_basedir configuration and runtime paths.

change: Creation of dynamic properties is deprecated, unless the class opts in by using the #[AllowDynamicProperties] attribute.
note: $this->x = 1 in a class without the declaration is reported.

change: Callables that are not accepted by the $callable() syntax (but are accepted by call_user_func) are deprecated.
note: 'self::g', ['parent', 'g'] and 'static::g' callables are reported.

change: The "${var}" and "${expr}" style string interpolations are deprecated and will be removed in PHP 9.

change: Use of QPrint, Base64, Uuencode, and HTML-ENTITIES 'text encodings' is deprecated for all Mbstring functions.

change: The SplFileInfo::_bad_state_ex() internal method has been deprecated.
note: ->_bad_state_ex() on an SplFileInfo object is reported.

change: utf8_encode() and utf8_decode() have been deprecated.
note: utf8_encode() and utf8_decode() calls are reported.

change: Programs that were very close to overflowing the call stack may now throw an Error when using more than `zend.max_allowed_stack_size-zend.reserved_stack_size` bytes of stack…
note: Depends on runtime stack depth.

change: Executing proc_get_status() multiple times will now always return the right value on posix systems.
note: Depends on runtime process status call sequence.

change: Zend Max Execution Timers is now enabled by default for ZTS builds on Linux.
note: ZTS build / SAPI internals.

change: Uses of traits with static properties will now redeclare static properties inherited from the parent class.
note: Not reported: class P { public static $x; } trait T { public static $x; } class C extends P { use T; } now gets separate storage.

change: Assigning a negative index n to an empty array will now make sure that the next index is n+1 instead of 0.
note: Not reported: $a = []; $a[-5] = 'a'; $a[] = 'b'; or [-5 => 'a', 'b'] where the next key is now -4.

change: Class constant visibility variance is now correctly checked when inherited from interfaces.
note: Not reported: interface I { const X = 1; } class C implements I { private const X = 2; }.

change: WeakMaps entries whose key maps to itself (possibly transitively) may now be removed during cycle collection if the key is not reachable except by iterating over the WeakMap (reachability via…
note: Garbage-collection behavior of WeakMap entries at runtime.

change: In addition to whitespace characters, now comments are allowed between `yield` and `from`.
note: yield /* comment */ from was a syntax error before; only tokenizer output changes.

change: DOMChildNode::after(), DOMChildNode::before(), DOMChildNode::replaceWith() on a node that has no parent is now a no-op instead of a hierarchy exception, which is the behaviour spec demands.
