change: Using the DOMParentNode and DOMChildNode methods without a document now works instead of throwing a HIERARCHY_REQUEST_ERR DOMException.
note: Depends on DOM node document state at runtime.

change: createAttributeNS() without specifying a prefix would incorrectly create a default namespace, placing the element inside the namespace instead of the attribute.
note: DOM namespace bugfix depends on runtime arguments and document.

change: createAttributeNS() would previously incorrectly throw a NAMESPACE_ERR when the prefix was already used for a different uri.
note: DOM namespace bugfix depends on runtime prefix conflicts.

change: New methods and properties were added to some DOM classes.
note: DOMElement subclass declaring incompatible toggleAttribute() / contains() is reported.

change: C functions that have a return type of void now return null instead of returning the following object object(FFI\CData:void) { }
note: FFI return value depends on runtime C function signatures.

change: The opcache.consistency_checks INI directive was removed.
note: opcache.consistency_checks is reported in php.ini, .user.ini, .htaccess and ini_set().

change: The type of Phar class constants are now declared.
note: Not reported: class P extends Phar { const SHA1 = []; } redeclaring a now-typed constant with another type.

change: The range() function has had various changes:
note: Mostly runtime, but literal range(1, 10, 0), range(1, 10, -1), range('', 'z') and range([1], 5) are not reported.

change: The file() flags error check now catches all invalid flags.
note: file('x', FILE_APPEND) is reported.

change: The type of SNMP class constants are now declared.
note: Not reported: class S extends SNMP { const VERSION_1 = 'x'; } redeclaring a now-typed constant with another type.

change: Using the ++ operator on empty, non-numeric, or non-alphanumeric strings is now deprecated.
note: Whether the incremented string is empty or non-alphanumeric depends on runtime values.

change: Using the -- operator on empty or non-numeric strings is now deprecated.
note: Whether the decremented string is empty or non-numeric depends on runtime values.

change: Calling get_class() and get_parent_class() without arguments is now deprecated.
note: get_class() and get_parent_class() without arguments are reported.

change: Calling dba_fetch() with $dba as the 3rd argument is now deprecated.
note: dba_fetch('k', 0, $dba) is reported.

change: Calling FFI::cast(), FFI::new(), and FFI::type() statically is now deprecated.
note: Not reported: static FFI::cast('int', $x) / FFI::new('int') / FFI::type('int').

change: The U_MULTIPLE_DECIMAL_SEP*E*RATORS constant had been deprecated, using the U_MULTIPLE_DECIMAL_SEP*A*RATORS instead is recommended.
note: U_MULTIPLE_DECIMAL_SEPERATORS constant is reported.

change: The NumberFormatter::TYPE_CURRENCY has been deprecated.
note: NumberFormatter::TYPE_CURRENCY is reported.

change: Calling ldap_connect() with separate hostname and port is deprecated.
note: ldap_connect('h', 389) is reported.

change: Passing a negative $width to mb_strimwidth() is now deprecated.
note: mb_strimwidth($s, 0, -5) is reported.

change: Calling Phar::setStub() with a resource and a length is now deprecated.
note: Not reported: $p = new Phar('x.phar'); $p->setStub($fp, 100) with a length argument.

change: The MT_RAND_PHP Mt19937 variant is deprecated.
note: mt_srand(1, MT_RAND_PHP) is reported.

change: The assert_options() function is now deprecated.
note: assert_options() call is reported.

change: The ASSERT_ACTIVE, ASSERT_BAIL, ASSERT_CALLBACK, ASSERT_EXCEPTION, and ASSERT_WARNING constants have been deprecated.
note: ASSERT_ACTIVE/BAIL/CALLBACK/EXCEPTION/WARNING constants are reported.

change: Using exceptions is now preferred, warnings will be removed in the future.
note: Not reported: (new SQLite3('x'))->enableExceptions(false).

change: The ZipArchive::FL_RECOMPRESS constant is deprecated and will be removed in a future version of libzip
note: ZipArchive::FL_RECOMPRESS is reported.

change: The assert.* INI settings have been deprecated.
note: assert.* settings in php.ini and ini_set('assert.exception', ...) are reported.

change: The type of PHP_DEBUG and PHP_ZTS constants changed to bool.
note: PHP_DEBUG/PHP_ZTS are now bool; literal comparisons like `PHP_DEBUG === 1` were tested and not reported.

change: The name of uploaded files and files created by the tempnam() function are now 13 bytes longer.
note: Longer tempnam()/upload file names only matter if code depends on the generated name length.

change: Encountering recursion during comparison now results in a Error exception, rather than a fatal error.
note: Recursion during comparison depends on runtime object graphs.

change: Indirect modification of readonly properties within __clone() is no longer allowed, e.g. $ref = &$this->readonly.
note: `$ref = &$this->readonlyProp` inside __clone() on a declared readonly property was tested and not reported.

change: The exit (and die) language constructs now behave more like a function.
note: TypeErrors from exit()/die() depend on argument types; literal exit(true)/die(1.5)/exit(null) were not reported, but common int/string calls are unaffected.

change: The E_STRICT constant was deprecated and its corresponding error level was removed.
note: E_STRICT usage in error_reporting() is reported.

ext: Extension Class constants are now typed
change: Date
note: Overriding a now-typed internal constant with another type, e.g. `class D extends DateTime { const ATOM = 5; }`, is not reported.

ext: Extension Class constants are now typed
change: Intl
note: Overriding a typed Intl class constant, e.g. `class C extends Collator { const DEFAULT_VALUE = 'x'; }`, is not reported.

ext: Extension Class constants are now typed
change: PDO
note: Overriding a typed PDO constant, e.g. `class Q extends PDO { const PARAM_INT = 'x'; }`, is not reported.

ext: Extension Class constants are now typed
change: Reflection
note: Overriding a typed Reflection constant, e.g. `class R extends ReflectionMethod { const IS_PUBLIC = 'x'; }`, is not reported.

ext: Extension Class constants are now typed
change: SPL
note: Overriding a typed SPL constant, e.g. `class A extends ArrayObject { const STD_PROP_LIST = 'x'; }`, is not reported.

ext: Extension Class constants are now typed
change: Sqlite
note: Overriding a typed SQLite class constant in a subclass with a different type is not reported.

ext: Extension Class constants are now typed
change: XMLReader
note: Overriding a typed XMLReader constant, e.g. `class X extends XMLReader { const ELEMENT = 'x'; }`, is not reported.

change: DBA: . dba_open() and dba_popen() will now return Dba\Connection
note: is_resource() on a dba_open() result is reported.

change: ODBC: . odbc_connect() and odbc_pconnect() will now return Odbc\Connection .
note: is_resource() on odbc_connect()/odbc_exec() results is reported.

change: SOAP: . SoapClient::$httpurl is now a Soap\Url object rather than a resource.
note: `is_resource($client->httpurl)` / `is_resource($client->sdl)` on a SoapClient was tested and not reported.

change: Curl: . curl_multi_select throws a ValueError if the timeout argument if it's negative or greater than PHP_INT_MAX.
note: curl_multi_select($mh, -1) is reported.

change: GD: . imagejpeg/imagewebp/imagepng/imageavif throws an exception if an invalid quality parameter value is passed.
note: imagejpeg($im, null, 150) is reported.

change: Gettext: . bind_textdomain_codeset, textdomain and d(*)gettext functions now throw an exception if the domain argument is empty.
note: textdomain('') is reported.

change: Intl: . IntlCalendar::set(), IntlCalendar::setDate(), IntlCalendar::setDateTime(), and IntlGregorianCalendar date/time construction now report the correct argument position for out-of-bounds…
note: Out-of-bounds integer values and ResourceBundle offsets depend on runtime values.

change: MBString: . mb_encode_numericentity() and mb_decode_numericentity() now check that the $map is only composed of integers, if not a ValueError is thrown.
note: Map entry types, mb_http_input type and null bytes in encodings normally come from runtime data.

change: ODBC: . odbc_fetch_row() now emits a warning when a value less than or equal to 0 is passed for parameter $row.
note: odbc_fetch_row($r, 0) is reported.

change: PCNTL: . The functions pcntl_sigprocmask(), pcntl_sigwaitinfo() and pcntl_sigtimedwait() now throw:
note: Empty or invalid signal arrays depend on runtime values.

change: SimpleXML: . Calling simplexml_import_dom() with a non-XML object now throws a TypeError instead of a ValueError.
note: Only the thrown exception class changes for invalid runtime objects.

change: Standard: . round() now validates the value of the $mode parameter and throws a ValueError for invalid modes.
note: Literal invalid round() modes and php_uname() modes are reported; a multi-byte str_getcsv() separator and a string allowed_classes are not.

change: XMLReader: . Passing an invalid character encoding to XMLReader::open() or XMLReader::XML() now throws a ValueError.
note: Invalid encodings or null bytes passed to XMLReader come from runtime values.

change: XMLWriter: . Passing an encoding containing null bytes previously emitted a warning and now throws a ValueError.
note: Null bytes in XMLWriter encoding depend on runtime values.

change: XSL: . XSLTProcessor::setParameter() will now throw a ValueError when its arguments contain null bytes.
note: Null bytes in XSLT parameters and non-XML objects depend on runtime values.

change: Some DOM methods previously returned false or a PHP_ERR DOMException if a new node could not be allocated.
note: Node allocation failure is practically unreachable; only a tentative return type changed.

change: Previously, DOMXPath objects could be cloned, but resulted in an unusable object.
note: `clone $xpath` on a `new DOMXPath(...)` variable was tested and not reported.

change: Removed DOMImplementation::getFeature().
note: DOMImplementation::getFeature() call is reported.

change: The GMP class is now final and cannot be extended anymore.
note: `class G extends GMP {}` was tested and not reported.

change: On invalid strings (those with encoding errors), mb_substr() now interprets character indices in the same manner as most other mbstring functions.
note: mb_substr() index semantics on invalid strings depend on runtime string contents.

change: For SJIS-Mac (MacJapanese) strings, character indices passed to mb_substr() now refer to the indices of the Unicode codepoints which are produced when the string is converted to Unicode.
note: SJIS-Mac index semantics depend on runtime string contents.

change: The unused and undocumented constant MYSQLI_SET_CHARSET_DIR has been removed.
note: MYSQLI_SET_CHARSET_DIR is reported.

change: The MYSQLI_STMT_ATTR_PREFETCH_ROWS constant has been removed.
note: MYSQLI_STMT_ATTR_PREFETCH_ROWS is reported.

change: The MYSQLI_CURSOR_TYPE_FOR_UPDATE and MYSQLI_CURSOR_TYPE_SCROLLABLE constants have been removed.
note: MYSQLI_CURSOR_TYPE_FOR_UPDATE and MYSQLI_CURSOR_TYPE_SCROLLABLE are reported.

change: The unused MYSQLI_TYPE_INTERVAL constant, which is currently a stub and an alias for MYSQLI_TYPE_ENUM, has been removed.
note: MYSQLI_TYPE_INTERVAL is reported.

change: The error code reported for MySQL server wait timeouts has been changed from 2006 to 4031 for MySQL server versions 8.0.24 and above.
note: The error code comes from the server connection at runtime.

change: The JIT config defaults changed from opcache.jit=tracing and opcache.jit_buffer_size=0 to opcache.jit=disable and opcache.jit_buffer_size=64M, respectively.
note: php.ini setting opcache.jit_buffer_size without opcache.jit (JIT now silently stays disabled) was tested and not reported.

change: The maximum value of the opcache.interned_strings_buffer setting on 64bit architectures is now 32767 (it was previously 4095).
note: Raised maximum for opcache.interned_strings_buffer does not break existing configs.

change: If JIT is enabled, PHP will now exit with a fatal error on startup in case of JIT startup initialization issues.
note: JIT startup failure behavior is environment-specific, not source-level.

change: The functions pcntl_sigprocmask(), pcntl_sigwaitinfo() and pcntl_sigtimedwait() now always return false on failure.
note: Checking `pcntl_sigwaitinfo(...) === -1` (now returns false) was tested and not reported.

change: The bundled pcre2lib has been updated to version 10.44.
note: Regex literal with `{,3}` quantifier (now a quantifier) in preg_match() was tested and not reported.

change: setAttribute, DBLIB_ATTR_STRINGIFY_UNIQUEIDENTIFIER and DBLIB_ATTR_DATETIME_CONVERT have been changed to set value as a bool.
note: setAttribute value types for DBLIB attributes depend on runtime values.

change: Since some Firebird C++ APIs are used now, this extension requires a C++ compiler to be built.
note: Build requirement for PDO_FIREBIRD.

change: getAttribute, ATTR_AUTOCOMMIT has been changed to get the value as a bool.
note: getAttribute() now returns bool; impact depends on how the value is compared at runtime.

change: getAttribute, ATTR_AUTOCOMMIT, ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES, MYSQL_ATTR_DIRECT_QUERY have been changed to get values as bool.
note: getAttribute() now returns bool; impact depends on how the value is compared at runtime.

change: The DSN's credentials, when set, are given priority over their PDO constructor counterparts, being closer to the documentation states.
note: DSN credential priority depends on runtime DSN/argument values.

change: Get methods called, or casting to a string on a SimpleXMLElement will no longer implicitly reset the iterator data, unless explicitly rewound.
note: SimpleXML iterator reset behavior depends on runtime iteration.

change: SoapClient::$typemap is now an array rather than a resource.
note: `is_resource($client->typemap)` on a SoapClient was tested and not reported.

change: The SOAP extension gained an optional dependency on the session extension.
note: Build/rtld-now configuration issue.

change: strcspn() with empty $characters now returns the length of the string instead of incorrectly stopping at the first NUL character.
note: strcspn() with empty characters normally comes from a variable.

change: http_build_query() now correctly handles backed enums.
note: Backed enums in http_build_query() data depend on runtime values.

change: stream_bucket_make_writeable() and stream_bucket_new() will now return a StreamBucket instance instead of an instance of stdClass.
note: StreamBucket vs stdClass only matters for runtime type checks inside stream filters.

change: Failures in the constructor now throw exceptions rather than emitting warnings and having a broken object.
note: Tidy constructor failures depend on runtime input.

change: The xml_set_*_handler() functions now declare and check for an effective signature of callable|string|null for the $handler parameters.
note: xml_set_object() is reported, but calling xml_set_*_handler() with method-name strings before xml_set_object() and passing '' are not.

change: Implicitly nullable parameter types are now deprecated.
note: `int $x = null` parameter is reported.

change: Passing E_USER_ERROR to trigger_error() is now deprecated.
note: trigger_error('x', E_USER_ERROR) is reported.

change: Using "_" as a class name is now deprecated.
note: `class _ {}` was tested and not reported.

change: Raising zero to the power of negative number is deprecated.
note: pow(0, -2) with literals is reported; the 0 ** -1 operator form is not.

change: The E_STRICT constant was deprecated and its corresponding error level was removed.
note: E_STRICT constant use is reported.

change: The CURLOPT_BINARYTRANSFER constant is deprecated.
note: CURLOPT_BINARYTRANSFER is reported.

change: Calling DatePeriod::__construct(string $isostr, int $options = 0) is deprecated.
note: `new DatePeriod('R4/2012-07-01T00:00:00Z/P7D')` (ISO string constructor) was tested and not reported.

change: Constants SUNFUNCS_RET_TIMESTAMP, SUNFUNCS_RET_STRING, and SUNFUNCS_RET_DOUBLE are now deprecated, following the deprecation of the associated date_sunset() and date_sunrise() functions in PHP 8.1.
note: All three SUNFUNCS_RET_* constants are reported.

change: Passing null or false to dba_key_split() is deprecated.
note: dba_key_split(null) is reported.

change: Deprecated DOM_PHP_ERR constant.
note: DOM_PHP_ERR is reported.

change: DOMDocument::$actualEncoding, DOMDocument::config, DOMEntity::$actualEncoding, DOMEntity::$encoding, DOMEntity::$version have been deprecated.
note: `$doc->actualEncoding` / `$doc->config` on a new DOMDocument were tested and not reported.

change: Deprecated passing incorrect data types for options to ext/hash functions.
note: Literal wrong option types like `hash('murmur3a', $d, false, ['seed' => 'abc'])` were tested and not reported.

change: Calling intlcal_set() as well as calling IntlCalendar::set() with more than 2 arguments is deprecated.
note: intlcal_set() is reported, but `$cal->set(2020, 1, 1)` on an IntlCalendar/IntlGregorianCalendar with more than 2 arguments is not.

change: Calling intlgregcal_create_instance() as well as calling IntlGregorianCalendar::__construct() with more than 2 arguments is deprecated.
note: intlgregcal_create_instance() is reported, but `new IntlGregorianCalendar(2020, 1, 1)` is not.

change: Calling ldap_connect() with more than 2 arguments is deprecated.
note: ldap_connect() with 3 arguments is reported (as an arity issue).

change: Calling ldap_exop() with more than 4 arguments is deprecated.
note: ldap_exop($l, $o, null, null, $r, $m) is reported.

change: The mysqli_ping() function and mysqli::ping() method are now deprecated, as the reconnect feature was removed in PHP 8.2.
note: mysqli_ping() and $mysqli->ping() are reported.

change: The mysqli_kill() function and mysqli::kill() method are now deprecated.
note: mysqli_kill() and $mysqli->kill() are reported.

change: The mysqli_refresh() function and mysqli::refresh() method are now deprecated.
note: mysqli_refresh(), ->refresh() and MYSQLI_REFRESH_* constants are reported.

change: Passing explicitly the $mode parameter to mysqli_store_result() has been deprecated.
note: mysqli_store_result($l, 0) is reported; the $m->store_result(0) method form is not.

change: Using escaped question marks (??) inside dollar-quoted strings is deprecated.
note: SQL literal with `??` inside `$$...$$` passed to a pgsql PDO prepare() was tested and not reported.

change: Calling pg_fetch_result() with 2 arguments is deprecated.
note: pg_fetch_result($r, 'col') is reported.

change: Calling pg_field_prtlen() with 2 arguments is deprecated.
note: pg_field_prtlen($r, 'col') is reported.

change: Calling pg_field_is_null() with 2 arguments is deprecated.
note: pg_field_is_null($r, 'col') is reported.

change: lcg_value() is deprecated, as the function is broken in multiple ways.
note: lcg_value() is reported.

change: Calling ReflectionMethod::__construct() with 1 argument is deprecated.
note: `new ReflectionMethod('A::b')` with one argument was tested and not reported.

change: Calling session_set_save_handler() with more than 2 arguments is deprecated.
note: session_set_save_handler() with six callables is reported.

change: Changing the INI settings session.sid_length and session.sid_bits_per_character is deprecated.
note: session.sid_length/sid_bits_per_character in ini_set() and php.ini are reported.

change: Changing the INI settings session.use_only_cookies, session.use_trans_sid, session.trans_sid_tags, session.trans_sid_hosts, and session.referer_check is deprecated.
note: session.use_trans_sid, referer_check and use_only_cookies are reported; the SID constant is not.

change: Passing an int to SoapServer::addFunction() is now deprecated.
note: addFunction(SOAP_FUNCTIONS_ALL) is reported via the constant, but addFunction() with a literal int like 999 is not.

change: The SOAP_FUNCTIONS_ALL constant is now deprecated.
note: SOAP_FUNCTIONS_ALL is reported.

change: The SplFixedArray::__wakeup() method has been deprecated as it implements __serialize() and __unserialize() which need to be overwritten instead.
note: Overriding and calling SplFixedArray::__wakeup() are reported.

change: Using the default value for $escape parameter of:
note: SplFileObject fgetcsv()/fputcsv()/setCsvControl() without $escape were tested and not reported.

change: Calling stream_context_set_option() with 2 arguments is deprecated.
note: stream_context_set_option($ctx, ['ssl' => []]) is reported.

change: Unserializing strings using the uppercase 'S' tag is deprecated.
note: Literal `unserialize('S:1:"a";')` with uppercase S tag was tested and not reported.

change: Using the default value for $escape parameter of:
note: fputcsv()/fgetcsv()/str_getcsv() without $escape are reported.

change: The xml_set_object() function has been deprecated.
note: xml_set_object() is reported.

change: Passing non-callable strings to the xml_set_*_handler() functions is now deprecated.
note: xml_set_object() is reported, but the xml_set_*_handler() calls with non-callable method-name strings or '' are not.

change: The IMAP extension has been unbundled and moved to PECL.
note: imap_open() is reported.

change: The OCI8 extension has been unbundled and moved to PECL.
note: oci_connect() is reported.

change: The PDO_OCI extension has been unbundled and moved to PECL.
note: `new PDO('oci:dbname=...')` (unbundled PDO_OCI driver) was tested and not reported.

change: The pspell extension has been unbundled and moved to PECL.
note: pspell_new() is reported.

change: It is no longer possible to use "array" and "callable" as class alias names in class_alias().
note: class_alias() with array or callable as the alias is reported.

change: Loosely comparing uncomparable objects (e.g. enums, \CurlHandle and other internal classes) to booleans was previously inconsistent.
note: Loose comparison of uncomparable objects to booleans depends on runtime types.

change: The return value of gc_collect_cycles() no longer includes strings and resources that were indirectly collected through cycles.
note: gc_collect_cycles() return value depends on runtime state.

change: It is now allowed to substitute static with self or the concrete class name in final subclasses.
note: Relaxation: substituting static with self in final classes was previously not allowed.

change: The tick handlers are now deactivated after all shutdown functions, destructors have run and the output handlers have been cleaned up.
note: Tick handler timing during shutdown is runtime behavior.

change: Traits are now bound before the parent class.
note: Trait vs parent binding order effects depend on subtle runtime linking.

change: Errors emitted during compilation and class linking are now always delayed and handled after compilation or class linking.
note: Delayed compile/link error handling depends on runtime error handlers.

change: Exceptions thrown by user-defined error handlers when handling class linking errors are not promoted to fatal errors anymore and do not prevent linking.
note: Error handler exceptions during linking depend on runtime handlers.

change: Applying #[\Attribute] to an abstract class, enum, interface, or trait triggers an error during compilation.
note: #[Attribute] on an abstract class, interface, trait and enum was tested and not reported.

change: The disable_classes INI setting has been removed as it causes various engine assumptions to be broken.
note: disable_classes is reported in php.ini, .user.ini, .htaccess and ini_set().

change: Destructuring non-array values (other than NULL) using [] or list() now emits a warning.
note: Destructuring non-arrays usually involves variables; literal `[$a, $b] = 42` was not reported either.

change: A warning is now emitted when casting floats to int if they cannot be represented as one.
note: Out-of-range float to int casts depend on runtime values.

change: A warning is now emitted when casting NAN to other types.
note: NAN casts depend on runtime values; literal `(int) NAN` was not reported.

change: bzcompress() now throws a ValueError when $block_size is not between 1 and 9.
note: bzcompress($s, 10) is reported.

change: bzcompress() now throws a ValueError when $work_factor is not between 0 and 250.
note: bzcompress($s, 4, 300) is reported.

change: Cloning a DOMNamedNodeMap, DOMNodeList, Dom\NamedNodeMap, Dom\NodeList, Dom\HTMLCollection, and Dom\DtdNamedNodeMap now fails.
note: `clone $doc->childNodes` / `clone $doc->getElementsByTagName('a')` were tested and not reported.

change: finfo_file() and finfo::file() now throws a ValueError instead of a TypeError when $filename contains nul bytes.
note: Only the exception class changes for nul bytes in runtime filenames.

change: The extension now requires at least ICU 57.1.
note: ICU build requirement.

change: The behaviour of Collator::SORT_REGULAR with respect to handling numeric strings is now aligned with the behaviour of SORT_REGULAR in ext/standard.
note: Collator SORT_REGULAR results depend on runtime string values.

change: ldap_get_option() and ldap_set_option() now throw a ValueError when passing an invalid option.
note: Invalid LDAP option values normally come from runtime values.

change: Unicode data tables have been updated to Unicode 17.0
note: Unicode table update affects results for runtime string data.

change: Calling the mysqli constructor on an already-constructed object is now no longer possible and throws an Error.
note: Re-constructing an existing mysqli object depends on runtime object state.

change: ODBC now assumes that at least ODBC 3.5 functionality is available.
note: ODBC build definition change.

change: ODBC no longer has build flags to build against specific drivers (except for DB2) and removes special cases for those drivers.
note: ODBC build flags change.

change: The Opcache extension is now always built into the PHP binary and is always loaded.
note: php.ini `zend_extension=opcache.so` (now emits a warning since opcache is built in) was tested and not reported.

change: pcntl_exec() now throws ValueErrors when entries of the $args parameter contain null bytes.
note: Null bytes in pcntl_exec() args depend on runtime values.

change: pcntl_exec() now throws ValueErrors when entries or keys of the $env_vars parameter contain null bytes.
note: Null bytes in pcntl_exec() env vars depend on runtime values.

change: The extension is compiled without semi-deprecated PCRE2_EXTRA_ALLOW_LOOKAROUND_BSK compile option.
note: Regex literal with \K inside a lookaround, e.g. `/(?=a\K)b/`, was tested and not reported.

change: The constructor arguments set in conjunction with PDO::FETCH_CLASS now follow the usual CUFA (call_user_func_array) semantics.
note: Literal string-keyed constructor args `setFetchMode(PDO::FETCH_CLASS, 'X', ['name' => 1])` were tested and not reported.

change: Attempting to call PDOStatement::setFetchMode during a call to PDO::fetch(), PDO::fetchObject(), PDO::fetchAll(), for example using tricks such as passing the statement object as a constructor…
note: Calling setFetchMode() during a fetch depends on runtime call flow.

change: The value of the constants PDO::FETCH_GROUP, PDO::FETCH_UNIQUE, PDO::FETCH_CLASSTYPE, PDO::FETCH_PROPS_LATE, and PDO::FETCH_SERIALIZE have changed.
note: Changed constant values only matter if code hardcodes or persists the raw integers.

change: A ValueError is now thrown if PDO::FETCH_PROPS_LATE is used with a fetch mode different than PDO::FETCH_CLASS, consistent with other fetch flags.
note: Literal `fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC | PDO::FETCH_PROPS_LATE)` was tested and not reported.

change: A ValueError is now thrown if PDO::FETCH_INTO is used as a fetch mode in PDO::fetchAll(), similar to PDO::FETCH_LAZY.
note: Literal `fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_INTO)` was tested and not reported.

change: A ValueError is now thrown when trying to set a cursor name that is too long on a PDOStatement resulting from the Firebird driver.
note: Cursor name length depends on runtime values.

change: Attempting to write session data where $_SESSION has a key containing the pipe character will now emit a warning instead of silently failing.
note: Literal session key with a pipe `$_SESSION['a|b'] = 1` was tested and not reported.

change: Passing an XPath expression that returns something other than a node set to SimpleXMLElement::xpath() will now emit a warning and return false, instead of silently failing and returning an empty…
note: Literal non-node-set XPath `$xml->xpath('count(//a)')` was tested and not reported.

change: ArrayObject no longer accepts enums, as modifying the $name or $value properties can break engine assumptions.
note: `new ArrayObject(Suit::H)` with an enum case was tested and not reported.

change: SplFileObject::fwrite's parameter $length is now nullable.
note: Subclass override `fwrite(string $data, int $length = 0)` (now incompatible with ?int) was tested and not reported.

change: Using a printf-family function with a formatter that did not specify the precision previously incorrectly reset the precision instead of treating it as a precision of 0.
note: Literal format strings without precision digits like `printf('%.f', 1.5)` were tested and not reported.

change: SoapClient::__doRequest() expects a new, optional $uriParserClass parameter as described in https://wiki.php.net/rfc/url_parsing_api#plugability.
note: SoapClient subclass overriding __doRequest() without the new $uriParserClass parameter was tested and not reported.

change: Trying to produce output (e.g. with `echo`) within a user output handler is deprecated.
note: `ob_start(function ($b) { echo 'x'; return $b; })` was tested and not reported.

change: Non-canonical cast names (boolean), (integer), (double), and (binary) have been deprecated, use (bool), (int), (float), and (string) respectively.
note: (boolean)/(integer)/(double)/(binary) casts are reported.

change: The $exclude_disabled parameter of the get_defined_functions() function has been deprecated, as it no longer has any effect since PHP 8.0.
note: get_defined_functions(true) is reported.

change: Terminating case statements with a semicolon instead of a colon has been deprecated.
note: `case 1;` is reported.

change: The backtick operator as an alias for shell_exec() has been deprecated.
note: Backtick shell execution is reported.

change: Returning null from __debugInfo() has been deprecated.
note: `__debugInfo()` returning literal null was tested and not reported.

change: The report_memleaks INI directive has been deprecated.
note: report_memleaks in php.ini and ini_set() is reported.

change: Constant redeclaration has been deprecated.
note: Redeclaring a constant with define() twice or `const B` twice was tested and not reported.

change: Enacted the follow-up phase of the "Path to Saner Increment/Decrement operators" RFC, meaning that incrementing non-numeric strings is now deprecated.
note: Incrementing a literal non-numeric string variable (`$s = 'abc'; $s++;`) was tested and not reported.

change: The following closure binding issues, which already emit an E_WARNING, are now deprecated:
note: Binding an object to a static closure via Closure::bind()/bindTo() and unbinding $this from a closure using $this were tested and not reported.

change: Using null as an array offset or when calling array_key_exists() is now deprecated.
note: `$a[null]` and `array_key_exists(null, $a)` are reported.

change: Deriving $_SERVER['argc'] and $_SERVER['argv'] from the query string for non-CLI SAPIs has been deprecated.
note: Whether argv comes from the query string depends on the SAPI at runtime.

change: The __sleep() and __wakeup() magic methods have been soft-deprecated.
note: Soft deprecation only, but defining __sleep()/__wakeup() in a user class was tested and not reported.

change: The curl_close() function has been deprecated, as CurlHandle objects are freed automatically.
note: curl_close() is reported.

change: The curl_share_close() function has been deprecated, as CurlShareHandle objects are freed automatically.
note: curl_share_close() is reported.

change: The DATE_RFC7231 and DateTimeInterface::RFC7231 constants have been deprecated.
note: DATE_RFC7231, DateTimeInterface::RFC7231 and DateTime::RFC7231 are reported.

change: The __wakeup() magic method of DateTimeInterface, DateTime, DateTimeImmutable, DateTimeZone, DateInterval, and DatePeriod has been deprecated in favour of the __unserialize() magic method.
note: Calling and overriding DateTime::__wakeup() are reported.

change: The finfo_close() function has been deprecated.
note: finfo_close() is reported.

change: The $context parameter of the finfo_buffer() and finfo::buffer() functions has been deprecated as it is ignored.
